senses.definition: n.pr.loc. place in the tribe of Zebulun Jos 19:14; 𝔊 Αμωθ, A Ενναθωθ, 𝔊L Αναθωθ; site unknown; according to Conder = Talm. Caphar Hanania (NbrGéogr. 176, 226) on the border of Upper and Lower Galilee, mod. Kefrʾ Anân, SurveyWP i, 205, 207.
